provider: ethstorage / evmfs / on-chain calldata file systems

free_tier.stated: None. Files are stored on-chain in FlatDirectory contracts, billed per transaction with calldata or blob upload types; the DA comparison page prices calldata at 9.98 USD per MB.

reliability_note: Real systems (EthStorage mainnet chain 333, FlatDirectory contracts; EVMFS 20 KB chunks per call) but pricing is per-calldata-byte. Calldata is $11.01/MB live. 10 TiB would be ~$115 million.

evidence.quote: About 818 times cheaper right now: 1 MB costs $0.012 as blobs and $9.98 as calldata. Blobs have their own fee market and are pruned after about 18 days, while calldata is kept forever and priced as execution gas.

evidence.proved: uploads are billed on-chain via calldata or blob transaction types, not a free tier
evidence.quote: Notice that you have 2 options to specify the file upload type: `calldata`, `blob`. The default type is `blob` which requires network support for EIP-4844.
